Widget API

The Widget API lets you create widgets. See the auth guide first.

Installation

npm install @acme/widget

Parameters

NameTypeRequired
idstringyes
labelstringno

Steps

  1. Import the client
  2. Configure options
    • Set the apiKey
    • Set the region
  3. Call create()

Note: rate limits apply.
